title: New boss Maresca is perfect for Man City - Gvardiol
summary: Manchester City defender Josko Gvardiol has endorsed new manager Enzo Maresca as a "perfect" fit for the club. The backing from a prominent squad member reflects early optimism about Maresca's appointment to lead the team.
content: New manager Enzo Maresca is a "perfect one" for Manchester City, says defender Josko Gvardiol.

zh.title: 新任主帅马雷斯卡是曼城的完美人选 - 瓜尔迪奥尔
zh.summary: 曼城后卫若斯科·瓜尔迪奥尔支持新任主管恩佐·马雷斯卡是俱乐部的"完美"人选。这位主力队员的支持反映了对马雷斯卡任命领导球队的早期乐观态度。

title: Who am I? Guess Premier League star No 13
summary: BBC Sport presents an interactive guessing game challenging readers to identify a Premier League player with minimal clues. The daily puzzle tests fans' knowledge of current league stars and recognition ability.
content: Work out the identity of today's player in as few attempts as possible.

zh.title: 我是谁？猜猜英超球星第13号
zh.summary: BBC体育推出一款互动猜谜游戏，挑战读者用最少的线索识别一名英超球员。这个每日谜题测试球迷对当前联赛球星的了解和识别能力。

title: What happened to star signings your club never made?
summary: BBC Sport examines star players who came close to joining Premier League clubs but whose transfers ultimately fell through. The feature explores how high-profile deals collapsed and their potential impact on squad development.
content: BBC Sport takes a look at some star players who were close to moving to the Premier League, only for the deals to fall through.

zh.title: 你的俱乐部从未签下的明星球员后来怎样了？
zh.summary: BBC体育检视了那些接近加盟英超俱乐部但最终转会失败的明星球员。该特稿探讨了高调交易如何落空以及对球队阵容发展的潜在影响。
